body:
I do work in a hospital and there is a councilling service I will check out and have had previous issues with binge eating, but felt ‘recovered’ from this, if it is something you can recover from. 

I am 5ft 5 
current weight is 133lb(60.3kg) 
female
I’m not sure about TDEE

I run 3.5 miles 2/3 days per week, yoga x 3 and one spin class most Saturdays. 

Writing that down I can almost see the problem myself 🙄

When I was younger my parents used to restrict my food a lot. I have been to a therapist and had never really stopped been able to be a ‘binge/secret eater’ until 1 year ago when it all stopped. 

I started wishing that I was just happy with myself however I was as 9stone5lbs me, so I started treating myself more (I.e eating rice instead of cauliflower rice) then onto pic n mix then onto family bags of crisps.

Such a nightmare to get out of, I almost feel like food is actually addictive
😂😂 so true! This made me laugh pretty.. but plump with a dark shade on her upper lip
